entities.summary: Hashemite-led Arab Revolt, a transformative movement in Jordan (1916–1918). Emerged from Ottoman Empire and Arab Revolt forces advance through Transjordan toward Damascus. Catalyzed Lawrence and T.E. Lawrence and Arab forces capture Aqaba in a daring desert assault.
